title: Iwaniec Conjecture for the Beurling-Ahlfors Transform Norm
exact_target: Is the exact norm of the Beurling--Ahlfors transform on every complex-valued $L^p$ space equal to $p^*-1$?

sources.citation: Rodrigo Banuelos, Cotlar martingale transforms and related singular integrals, arXiv:2604.09365v2 (2026).
